name: Pink Noise Transmittance via Ensemble Averaging
definition: A method to compute transmittance for media characterized by 1/f (pink) fractal noise by interpreting the macroscopic transmittance as an ensemble average of random homogeneous realizations with extinction coefficients drawn from a distribution pdf(σµ).
summary: Pink Noise Transmittance via Ensemble Averaging computes transmittance for 1/f fractal noise media by averaging random homogeneous realizations, enabling fast, unbiased delta tracking where standard methods fail.
